source: Market research (2025-2026 postings + skills/hiring reports) — CLUSTER-QUAL-001 stage 4 (spec 7.6), weekly refresh
method: 9 parallel WebSearch research passes (one per cluster), each given the currently-shipped top-20 as baseline and asked to produce evidence-backed updates only (keep/reorder/merge/add/drop), never fabricate. Google CSE proxy (/api/cse-search) not used this run: no CSE_PROXY_TOKEN in this session's env, and per docs/deployment/google-cse-setup.md §6 the Google path still 403s (entitlement hold, support case open) while the Brave-first fix is committed but not yet deployed to access-relay. Fallback = plain WebSearch, same as 2026-07-10/07-13. This run is 11 days stale versus the last shipped refresh (2026-07-13) — the 2026-07-17 scheduled fire produced no report/push (silent no-op, see docs/qa/SCHEDULED_ROUTINES.md STANDING RULE 0), so this run carries two weeks of market drift.
note: All 9 clusters returned evidence-backed changes this run — larger than a typical single-week tuning pass, consistent with the 11-day gap since the last real refresh. Dominant cross-cluster signal: AI/GenAI fluency continues to climb (now denominated as a baseline expectation, not just a rising skill, in software/data/consulting/executive/finance/HR); several clusters also promoted human-differentiator skills (critical thinking, business acumen, EI, communication) on the reasoning that as AI absorbs mechanical work, judgment/communication skills that AI can't replicate rise in relative hiring value. Denmark/Nordic-specific sourcing found for pm_process, photonics_eng (NKT Photonics, Sparrow Quantum, imec), research_phd (DTU), engineering_software, data_analytics, finance, people_soft (Nordic HR Outlook, Simployer) — executive and consulting leaned more on international sources with a Nordic English-fluency baseline item retained. Untargeted (unsolicited) scoring spans ALL 9 clusters (owner 2026-07-05) so an open CV is weighted by whole-market demand. The live D1 path (antcv-cluster-demand-live.js) overtakes this per-user once real-JD data accumulates.
